feedback.answered: The composed verification path has no observed suffrage filter: verifyLeader registers every replicator, notifyAll forwards booleans, and verifyFuture.vote only tallies. The separate lease checker does filter Voters, so timing and actual loss of authority remain essential premises. Current source also differs from the older membership proposal: AddVoter grants voting status directly and GetConfiguration returns latest, potentially uncommitted configuration. The map follows the current code and interface rather than treating the proposal as current behavior.

This sourced mismatch warrants a targeted legal-history check rather than assuming the separate lease closes the timing window.
